svg.title: dynamic_cast memory layout diagram
svg.desc: Shows what happens in memory for a successful and a failed dynamic_cast, including the heap object, vptr, vtable, and RTTI chain.

g.text: vptr → type_info reads "Derived" — matches target → returns same address as bp
vptr → type_info reads "Derived" — "Other" not in hierarchy → returns nullptr, no crash

svg.text: No virtual fn → no vtable → no vptr → no RTTI → dynamic_cast cannot compile
